outcome: A fresh read-only observer can reconstruct why a product is or is not complete, who owns remaining work, which semantic obligation and authority chain led to the current state, which exact execution policy/strategy/config/attempt/runtime produced evidence, and how long work waited versus executed, using only durable canonical provenance and never model inference or acceptance authority.
currentProblem: Integration B through H establish durable execution, lineage, deployment/QA, closure and recovery semantics, but the system has no canonical read-only causal reconstruction boundary that joins those refs into one evidence-backed explanation. Some lifecycle timing is not durably represented, so waiting/executing metrics cannot be guessed from process logs or conversation history.
constraints: Observation is read-only and cannot accept/reject work, mutate product currentness, claim work, select execution strategy or trigger recovery.
Every reported fact binds durable artifact/head refs; missing provenance is reported as UNKNOWN/MISSING_PROVENANCE rather than inferred.
Execution policy, strategy, context/tool/model/harness config, semantic attempt and runtime invocation identity come from exact ExecutionAttemptBinding/RuntimeExecutionAttestation refs.
Why-not-done and remaining-work facts derive from canonical ProductStateProjection plus current obligations/work, not caller-selected subsets.
Ownership derives from canonical WorkContract/current lifecycle authority; observer does not choose or reassign owner.
Waiting/executing durations use owner-recorded durable boundary timestamps only; process logs and wall-clock inference are not evidence.
Causal observation records are immutable evidence, not product authority and not ProductHistory transitions.
Current and historical queries are explicit: current resolves canonical heads; historical reconstruction pins exact subject refs.
Observer output carries evidenceRefs for each fact so a fresh consumer can independently resolve the chain.
No generic telemetry platform, log warehouse, tracing backend or LLM-generated causal explanation is required for Integration I.
successCriteria: For a NOT_READY product, a fresh observer identifies the exact blocker reason and evidence refs from canonical product/lineage state without caller-supplied blocker refs.
For each remaining actionable work item, the observer identifies the exact owning domain and current lifecycle/claim state without choosing a next domain.
For a failed or non-current semantic obligation, the observer traces the issuing semantic subject, obligation revision, affected downstream work and invalidation evidence.
For an executed work item, the observer resolves exact ExecutionPolicy, ExecutionStrategyDescriptor and pinned context/tool/model/harness/runtime configuration from the immutable attempt binding.
The observer identifies the exact semantic executionAttemptId and runtimeInvocationId/attestation that produced execution evidence.
The observer reports waiting and executing durations from durable boundary timestamps; if required timestamps are absent it reports MISSING_PROVENANCE rather than estimating.
For each accepted product/quality claim surfaced in the explanation, the observer returns the exact evidence/publication/acceptance refs supporting it.
Deleting cached observation projections and reconstructing in a fresh process from the same pinned subject yields the same causal facts and evidence identities.
A historical query remains reconstructable after newer product transitions while a current query follows the newer canonical heads.
Observation APIs cannot mutate acceptance/currentness, dispatch work, resolve a new strategy or act as recovery/scheduling authority.
